nightshift.label: Nightshift
nightshift.description: Dark teal with gold art deco trim.

deadlock_api.description: OLED black with electric red glow.

statlocker.label: Statlocker
statlocker.description: Graphite panels with a mint-green accent.

flint_snow.label: Flint Snow
flint_snow.description: Coral fur on midnight navy with pink trim.

void.label: Void

catppuccin.label: Catppuccin

autostart.description_windows: Launches Deadlock+ when you sign in to Windows.
autostart.description_macos: Launches Deadlock+ when you log in to macOS.
autostart.description_linux: Launches Deadlock+ when you log in to your desktop.
autostart.failed: Couldn't change this setting. Check the log for details.
autostart.stale: Startup is set up for a different copy of Deadlock+. Turn it off and on to use this one.

startup.tray_description: Closing the window hides Deadlock+ instead of quitting, so monitoring keeps going. Quit from the tray icon.
startup.jobs_description: Deadlock+ scans your mods, gets patch notes ready to search and keeps your server blocks up to date in the background. These settings decide whether that work runs, and what it does while Deadlock is open.
startup.all_jobs_description: Turn this off and no task starts by itself. You can still run a scan from the Performance page.
startup.tasks_description: Each task can run by itself or not, and can pause, slow down or keep running while Deadlock is open.
startup.open_on_game_start_description: Shows the Deadlock+ window when the game starts, even if Deadlock+ was in the tray.
startup.admin_access_description: Server blocks, the connection monitor and frame times need Windows admin rights.

notifications.alerts_description: Notifies you when a new Deadlock patch note or Steam announcement is posted. Checks the public Deadlock API every 15 minutes and sends nothing about you. Needs the app running, so pair it with the tray option.
notifications.maintenance_description: Notifies you before Steam's weekly maintenance, which can drop or restart servers. Valve publishes no schedule, so this is the usual slot (Tuesday evening, around 00:00 UTC Wednesday), not an official one. It usually lasts 15 to 30 minutes. Change it if yours differs. Needs the app running, so pair it with the tray option.
notifications.overlay_description: Show notifications on top of Deadlock while you play.
notifications.overlay_fullscreen: Deadlock is in Full Screen mode. Switch to Borderless Window to see the overlay over the game.
notifications.overlay_position_description: Where notifications appear over the game.
notifications.overlay_duration_description: How long each notification stays on screen.
notifications.overlay_test_description: Shows a sample notification over the game.
notifications.overlay_notifications_description: Turn Match found and other notifications on or off in Notifications.
notifications.overlay_test_failed: Couldn't show the test notification. Try again.
notifications.overlay_match_found_description: Tells you when your queue pops, even if another window is in front.
notifications.overlay_queue_stopped_description: Tells you when your queue stops without a match while another window is in front of Deadlock.
notifications.server_blocks_updated_description: Tells you when Valve changes server addresses and Deadlock+ updates your Server Picker blocks to match.
notifications.server_blocks_stale_description: Tells you when Deadlock+ could not update your Server Picker blocks, so some servers may not be blocked.
notifications.break_reminder_description: Suggests a break after several losses in a row in one session. Same switch as on the Sessions page.
notifications.front_page_after_match_description: Tosses a newspaper front page of the match onto the window when Deadlock+ captures the match at its end.
notifications.front_page_overlay_alert_description: Tells you in the game overlay when a front page is waiting in Deadlock+.
notifications.overlay_off_fallback: The game overlay is off, so this shows as a desktop notification.
notifications.overlay_off_hidden: The game overlay is off, so this does not show.
notifications.dispatch_alerts_description: Tells you when a new Deadlock+ Dispatch edition is out.

discord.presence_description: Show what you're playing on your Discord profile.
discord.level_detailed_description: Shows your hero, mode, rank and match timer.
discord.support_description: Adds a "Download Deadlock+" button to your activity so others can find the app. Works with Basic and Detailed.
discord.logo_description: Replaces the Deadlock logo on your activity whenever no other large image is shown.
discord.delay_description: Holds back what friends see on Discord by this long.
discord.clients_description: Pick which Discord apps show your presence.
discord.status_waiting: Discord is running. Waiting for Deadlock to start.

discord_editor.description: Change what each activity says. Pick a state, then edit its lines, images and timer. Anything you leave alone uses the built-in default.
discord_editor.reset_all_description: Every change you made to Discord activity text, images and timers is removed. Deadlock+ goes back to its built-in defaults.
discord_editor.preview_failed: Couldn't show the preview. Check this state's lines for a typo.
discord_editor.share_description: Copy preset puts your changes on the clipboard as text. Import replaces them with pasted text or a file.
discord_editor.save_failed: Couldn't save your Discord activity changes. Try again.
discord_editor.editing_default_hint: Changes here apply to every hero. Pick a hero to override only that hero's lines.
discord_editor.editing_hero_hint: Changes here apply only while you play {hero}. Fields you leave alone follow Default.
discord_editor.no_hero_layer: This state can't be set per hero. Changes apply to every hero.
discord_editor.variables_hint: Click a line, then insert a value into it.

placeholder.gameMode: Game mode, such as Street Brawl

discord_editor.preview_logo: Deadlock logo (Discord shows it when no large image is sent)
discord_editor.preview_discord_sample: Streak, Trending and playtime show here when Discord has them.

syntax.title: How lines work
syntax.rule_length: Each line must be 2 to 128 characters. Short lines are padded. Long lines are cut with an ellipsis.
syntax.rule_empty: A line you leave empty is hidden.
syntax.rule_unclosed: Forgot to close a [[ ? It shows as plain text.
syntax.rule_unknown: A misspelled variable shows as plain text.
syntax.privacy: Only you and your team are available. The match ID is hidden in private lobbies and on Basic. While you spectate, it only shows if you type it.
syntax.intro: Each line on your Discord card is short text. Mix plain words with values that fill themselves in.
syntax.step1_body: Put a word in curly brackets. Deadlock+ swaps it for the real thing while you play. Click an example to copy it.
syntax.step2_title: What if there is no value?
syntax.step2_body: Sometimes the game doesn't know something yet, like your rank. That part is simply left out. The words next to it stay.
syntax.step3_title: Show a part only when it works
syntax.step3_body: Put double square brackets around a part. If any value inside is missing, the whole part vanishes.
syntax.step4_body: Put two bars between choices. Deadlock+ shows the first choice that has all its values. End with plain words so there is always something to show.
syntax.list_body: Copy any of these into a line, or use the Insert value button. The example column shows how it looks right now.

discord_editor.party_size_hint: Adds the party count, like (2 of 6), when you are in a party of two or more.
discord_editor.detailed_only: Only Detailed uses these states. Basic always shows Playing.

privacy.telemetry_description: Sends which version and system you use, which pages you open, when you open the Discord invite, when an update is offered or started, and error reports. It uses a random ID that is not linked to you, and never sends paths, names, Steam IDs, IP addresses or match data.
privacy.telemetry_reset_failed: Couldn't reset the usage data ID. Try again.
privacy.ingest_no_cache: Couldn't find Steam's saved web data on this PC. Is Steam installed?
privacy.ingest_failed: The last upload failed. Check the log for details.
privacy.ingest_watching: Watching for new matches. {count} shared this session.
privacy.ingest_description: Gets your matches full details and replays on stat sites and in Match History.
privacy.gc_description: Fills in matches the Deadlock API is missing, yours and other players'.
privacy.ingest_how_find: Deadlock+ finds what's needed to load each match, on this PC and in Deadlock while you play.
privacy.ingest_how_send: It sends that, the match IDs and your Steam ID to the Deadlock API. Nothing else.
privacy.gc_how_login: Signs in to Steam with the login saved on this PC. Your login never leaves this PC.
privacy.gc_how_limit: Up to 40 matches per account a day.
privacy.gc_how_game: While Deadlock is open, it picks up matches you look at in the game instead of signing in.
privacy.gc_how_send: Sends only match IDs, Steam IDs and what's needed to load each match.
privacy.gc_own_description: Fills in every match in your history that the Deadlock API is missing.

about_page.auto_check_description: Asks GitHub for a newer release on launch and every hour after. Nothing installs without your click.

diagnostics.description: This session's log. Names in file paths are hidden when you copy or save it. Only needed when reporting a bug.

storage.subtitle: What Deadlock and Deadlock+ keep on this PC.
storage.footnote: Only things the game or Deadlock+ rebuild or keep for you can be cleared here. Everything else belongs to the game or your mod manager.

clear.title: Clear {name}?
clear.all_title: Clear all files that rebuild themselves?
clear.all_body: Frees {size} from: {names}. The game rebuilds these on its own. This can't be undone.

deadlock.label: Deadlock
deadlock.blurb: Files the game keeps on this PC.

mods.label: Mods and backups
mods.blurb: Handled by your mod tools. Not touched here.

history.label: History
history.hint: A record of the past. Can't be rebuilt once deleted.

backup.label: Backup
backup.hint: A safety copy. Only needed if something goes wrong.

managed.label: Managed by mods
managed.hint: Belongs to a mod or a mod manager.

replays.label: Replays
replays.consequence: Deleted replays are gone for good. Pick which ones to remove on the Replays page.

hero_presence_cache.label: Hero presence cache
hero_presence_cache.description: A small file the game rebuilds by itself.
hero_presence_cache.consequence: Rebuilt on the next launch. Too small to be worth clearing.

shader_cache.label: Shader cache
shader_cache.description: Compiled shaders, so the game doesn't rebuild them every match.
shader_cache.consequence: The game rebuilds it. The first match after clearing may stutter.

console_log.label: Console log
console_log.description: The game's console output. Only exists when it starts with -condebug.
console_log.consequence: Rewritten on every launch. Nothing you need is lost.

voice_ban_backups.label: Mute list backups
voice_ban_backups.description: Copies Deadlock+ makes each time you change your mute list.
voice_ban_backups.consequence: Clearing them removes your way back to an earlier mute list.

frame_runs.label: Frametime runs
frame_runs.consequence: Can't be recaptured. Delete single runs on the Performance page.

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Your Deadlock+ settings and window position.
settings.consequence: Not recoverable. Removing it resets your preferences.

server_presets.label: Server presets
server_presets.consequence: Not recoverable. You would have to build them again.

replay_rules.label: Replay pins and cleanup rules
replay_rules.description: Replays you pinned and your cleanup rules.
replay_rules.consequence: Without it, pinned replays lose their protection and cleanup rules reset.

connection_history.label: Connection history
connection_history.description: Ping and route samples recorded on the Live page.
connection_history.consequence: Past samples can't be recorded again. New ones start piling up from scratch.

notifications.label: Alerts and notifications
notifications.description: Alerts and notifications shown in the app.
notifications.consequence: Past entries are gone. Nothing else depends on them.

patch_notes_index.label: Patch notes search
patch_notes_index.description: Patch notes and the search index built from them.
patch_notes_index.consequence: Downloaded and made searchable again on its own, which takes a while and uses CPU.

stats_cache.label: Saved stats
stats_cache.description: Stats and match data fetched from the web.
stats_cache.consequence: Fetched again the next time you open Stats.

server_list_cache.label: Saved server list
server_list_cache.description: The last server list Server Picker loaded.
server_list_cache.consequence: Fetched again the next time you open Server Picker.

replay_info_cache.label: Saved replay details
replay_info_cache.description: Match details looked up for your replays.
replay_info_cache.consequence: Looked up again when you open a replay.

match_cache.label: Saved match details
match_cache.description: Full match scoreboards you opened in Match History.
match_cache.consequence: Fetched again the next time you open the match.

other_app_files.label: Other app files
other_app_files.description: Small files that don't fit anything above.
other_app_files.consequence: Reminders and leftovers. Not worth touching.

logs.label: App logs
logs.description: This app's log files, one archive per day.
logs.consequence: Only useful for bug reports. Clearing removes old days; today's log stays.

addons.label: Installed mods
addons.description: Files installed by mods or a mod manager, without the replays.
addons.consequence: Removing files here can break installed mods. Use your mod manager instead.

addons_backups.label: Mod backups
addons_backups.description: Backup copies of mods made by a mod manager.
addons_backups.consequence: Without them, you can't roll mods back to an earlier state.

config_backups.label: Config backups
config_backups.description: Config folders backed up by the game or a mod manager.
config_backups.consequence: Snapshots of your settings from before a change. Keep the latest one.

gameinfo_backups.label: gameinfo.gi backups
gameinfo_backups.description: Copies of gameinfo.gi made by mod tools.
gameinfo_backups.consequence: Restore points for the file that loads mods. Keep at least one.

postgame_detail.label: Post-game match data
postgame_detail.description: Full scoreboards of matches Deadlock+ captured from the game, kept until the Deadlock API has them.
postgame_detail.consequence: Matches the Deadlock API does not have yet lose their detail view. Their summary row stays.

match_ping.label: Match ping recordings
match_ping.description: Ping, loss and jitter recorded while each match ran, shown on the match detail ping card.
match_ping.consequence: Matches lose their recorded ping graph. The match you are playing right now is kept.

mvp_grades.label: Match grades
mvp_grades.description: The grades Deadlock+ worked out for your matches.
mvp_grades.consequence: Grades are worked out again on the next background run. Nothing else is lost.

shared_matches.label: Shared matches
shared_matches.description: Matches Deadlock+ shared with the Deadlock API.
shared_matches.consequence: Deadlock+ may share those matches again. Nothing else is lost.

dispatch_editions.label: Dispatch editions
dispatch_editions.description: The Dispatch editions Deadlock+ has issued for you.
dispatch_editions.consequence: Not recoverable. Past editions are not made again.
